A bottle of ’Sugar’ … an ingredient Scarlett's never been out of her entire life!
Sweet and delicious! You’d snack on these all day if you could!
To our weary traveler~ Get well soon! We are excited to meet you! The next page is a mess of signatures and paw prints.
A handy notebook that gives you access to the Critter Log, the Quest Log, and Gossiping with Critters!
Slip your arms into them, and voila! You’re kept afloat!
A sturdy building material, just perfect for reinforcing heavy structures like the town bridge…
It’s got all the right curves, and just enough girth to really fill ya up!
A scrumptious red apple from the tree near the northern mountains.
Money! Cash! Pesos! Collect enough of these coins and you can buy ALL the nifty goodies at The Musky Mustelid…
An empty glass jar. You could carry all sorts of fun stuff inside!
A heavy package for Scarlett. Contains two ball gags, one riders crop, two pairs of handcuffs and a full range of anal plugs…
A light package for Augustus. Contains an ancient relic of some sort.
Sharp and shiny, these salutary scissors are suitable for all sorts of shearing shenanigans.
A classic, practical tool for excavating and outdoor projects. Surprisingly, shovels are hard to come by in this forest!
Wear this in icy places, and cold can’t even touch you! Looks super styley too.
Some warm fluffy wool from Finley. Perfect sweater-making material!
This bell will summon Penny to the Lake fast travel perch!
This bell will summon Penny to the Central Forest fast travel perch!
This bell will summon Penny to the Mountain fast travel perch!
This bell will summon Penny to the Plains fast travel perch!
A gift from Ollie. It doesn't seem particularly lucky, but it was still thoughtful of him!
A gift from Scarlett. This nifty atlas helps travelers navigate the forest! Activate it with [M] or [Select].
A gift from Peter. The wearer might spot "very interesting things…"
A gift from Maverick. It's definitely broken, but it’s still an amusing conversation piece.
A gift from Augustus. It might help to decipher glyphs around the forest.
A musty piece of wood to the layman. A blank canvas to the artisan.
Expert Craftsmanship, a touch of Southern Comfort, and a heavy dose of Adult Innovation.
Tournament legal, professional-grade, wood and carbon fiber. A proper endgame-spanker.
Issue 68. Mint condition! Save for a recent stain… definitely not saliva.
You know what they say. One critter’s lace, is another critter’s bondage rope~!
Fully Adjustable, Customizable. Recommended use with silicone toys only.
Friendship cookies! Piping fresh and ready to go. These sugary snacks will surely help break the ice!
Part of a cookie Mabel couldn't finish. It's as sweet as the others, but moreso because you got to share it with her.
A special friendship cookie for Finley to help his old roommates make amends. The icing spells out "We're Sorry".
A box of Finley's stuff he left with his old roommates. Looks like some papers, paintbrushes, and a few bedroom toys.
A professional camera with a wide angle lens. Essential equipment for any kind of studio photography.
(Usable) A very special Season's Greetings card from Melody and Penny, featuring a spicy hot photo from the coldest time of year.
It's Mabel! She tied a string to herself, binding herself to you. Now she's riding securely in your pack.
A missing page that was flying around in the storm. Looks like Augustus' handwriting...
A jar of frisky fireflies. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
A jar of frisky fireflies. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
A jar of frisky fireflies that makes a great lantern. You'd like to watch what's happening in there, but they move around too fast!
An empty glass jar. You could carry all sorts of fun stuff inside!
A glass jar containing the "seed of a wolf." A tribe of forest mice asked you to obtain it for a peculiar ceremony...
During some Adventures, your other items are stored in the background. You'll see them again when the Adventure is finished!
(Usable) A series of steamy photographs of Melody from a secret modeling session in Maverick's back-room studio.
You’ve got a whole lot of it.
